title: Model
spec: Start by creating a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees and a translation vector also set to zero. Next, draw the first face, which consists of a single loop. In this loop, draw a circle centered at coordinates (0.0085, 0.0102) with a radius of 0.0085 meters. Proceed to draw the second face, again consisting of a single loop. In this loop, draw another circle centered at coordinates (0.0664, 0.0102) with a radius of 0.0102 meters. After drawing both faces, apply a uniform scale factor of 0.0766 to the entire two-dimensional sketch to adjust the dimensions. Transform the scaled sketch into three-dimensional space by rotating it using the Euler angles [0.0, 0.0, 0.0] and translating it using the translation vector [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]. Finally, extrude the sketch 0.75 meters along the normal direction to generate the three-dimensional model. Ensure that the extrusion does not occur in the opposite direction. The final dimensions of the model will be 0.0766 meters in length, 0.02045 meters in width, and 0.75 meters in height.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial coordinate system
workplane = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the first circle
circle_1 = workplane.center(0.0085, 0.0102).circle(0.0085)

# Create the second circle
circle_2 = workplane.center(0.0664, 0.0102).circle(0.0102)

# Extrude the circles to create the cylindrical structure
extrusion = circle_1.add(circle_2).extrude(0.75)

# The final model
r = extrusion

# Display the model

import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial coordinate system
workplane = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the first cylinder
cylinder_1 = (
    workplane
    .center(0.0098, 0.0098)  # Move to the center of the first circle
    .circle(0.0098)  # Create the first circle
    .extrude(0.75)  # Extrude the circle to create the first cylinder
)

# Create the second cylinder
cylinder_2 = (
    workplane
    .center(0.0668, 0.0098)  # Move to the center of the second circle
    .circle(0.0098)  # Create the second circle
    .extrude(0.75)  # Extrude the circle to create the second cylinder
)

# Combine the two cylinders
r = cylinder_1.union(cylinder_2)

lanes.label: Kimi K3 (high)
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Two parallel vertical rods with slightly different diameters.
# Bounding box: X 0.0766, Y 0.0204, Z 0.7500
# - Larger rod diameter = 0.0204 (sets Y extent)
# - Smaller rod diameter = 0.016
# - Both share the same Y center (0.0102), so they overlap in the RIGHT view

d_small = 0.016
d_large = 0.0204
height = 0.75

# Rod centers along X so overall X extent is 0.0766
x1 = d_small / 2.0                # left edge of small rod at X = 0
x2 = 0.0766 - d_large / 2.0       # right edge of large rod at X = 0.0766
y_center = d_large / 2.0          # both rods centered in Y

r = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .moveTo(x1, y_center)
    .circle(d_small / 2.0)
    .moveTo(x2, y_center)
    .circle(d_large / 2.0)
    .extrude(height)
)
